newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil - low sulphur balanced.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil - low sulphur balanced.

text.p: The low sulphur straight run market looked balanced on Thursday with prices settling around the $140 fob NWE done on Wednesday.

"There are a couple of big cargoes around, but small pieces are not visible," said one trader. A cargo out of Lexioes was said being offered around $147 cif. Dealers said there was potential for weakness on Friday since crude has lost ground and most prompt straight run business has been concluded.
Russian material was seen better offered in the Med than the north with M-40 quotes seen around $129-130 cif Med.
